scheduling.title: Scheduling
scheduling.bufferHelp: Padding before and after each appointment for cleanup / prep. Leave blank for none.
scheduling.advanceHelp: "Earliest" blocks bookings closer than this many hours from now. "Latest" blocks bookings further out than this many days.
scheduling.limitHelp: Off: this treatment is bookable whenever staff & business hours are open. On: only the days/hours you enable below are bookable.
scheduling.daysOffHelp: Days toggled off are closed for this treatment regardless of staff schedule.

businessHours.title: Business Hours
businessHours.description: Set your operating hours - these will control available time slots across all booking systems
businessHours.quickTemplatesHelp: One click sets hours + booking slot interval. You can fine-tune anything afterwards.
businessHours.slotIntervalHelp: How often a bookable time appears on the picker

schedulingConfiguration.title: Scheduling Configuration
schedulingConfiguration.description: Configure time slots and concurrent appointments for your business
schedulingConfiguration.layeringBody: Business Hours sets the outer bound. Configs here narrow the window further when no staff schedule applies.
schedulingConfiguration.layeringTail: (Settings → Staff Schedules) take precedence when set for a given day. Date overrides on a staff schedule replace the window for that exact date.
schedulingConfiguration.adminRequired: You need admin permissions to modify scheduling configurations.
schedulingConfiguration.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this configuration?
schedulingConfiguration.permissionModify: You don't have permission to modify scheduling configurations.
schedulingConfiguration.permissionDelete: You don't have permission to delete scheduling configurations.
schedulingConfiguration.saveError: Failed to save scheduling configuration. Please check your permissions.
schedulingConfiguration.deleteError: Failed to delete scheduling configuration. Please check your permissions.

timeGrid.empty: No times available on this day. Pick another date.

staffSchedulesSection.title: Staff Schedules
staffSchedulesSection.description: Set each staff member's working days and hours, plus dated overrides for vacation or one-off custom hours. These override the org's business hours for the selected staff. Used by the booking flow to compute available slots.

staffScheduleEditor.weeklyDescription: Working days and hours for {{name}}. When set, these override the org's business hours for this staff member only.
staffScheduleEditor.quickTemplatesHelp: One click fills in the weekly grid. Click Save to persist.
staffScheduleEditor.overridesDescription: Day-off, vacation, or custom hours for a specific date. Overrides win over the weekly schedule.
staffScheduleEditor.pickDateDescription: Date must be in YYYY-MM-DD format
